paragraphs.text: Auntie Blyte , Bad Influence , is a legendary Devil Advisor from an unknown plane introduced in Jumpstart 2022 .

Auntie Blyte is a very small red devil the size of a human's head. She wears a purple dress, has black bat wings, wears glasses, has two horns, and has flames coming off of her black hair. She is seen whispering into people's ears.
